'''Stasis vault 109''' was a security storage area located in the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Shange]] and others were kept in stasis there for over 20 years.
